_about: Example list using the fields that become actions through abbildung in ../.sichttest/sichttest.projekt.json. test_db runs before setup; test_db.ende is the teardown.
title: Database view
description: Queries and the database tab, against a seeded test database.

steps.title: Vorbereiten
steps.text: Database tab in front, test database `mytest` connected.

steps.title: Query returns all customers
steps.text:
Run [this query](sql:SELECT%20*%20FROM%20customers) in the [Database](tab:Database) tab.

**Pass** if 25 rows appear.

steps.title: Settings survive a restart
steps.text:
Change the row limit to 50, then let the application restart.

**Pass** if the limit is still 50.

steps.title: Export opens the result
steps.text: Export the result, then open [the export](file:out/export.csv).
